text: Turn every PR into a precomputed squash commit and require GitHub to merge that exact tree, making the tested object the merged object instead of rerunning after server-side synthesis.
rationale: This closes the commit-identity gap between local proof, hosted proof, and squash merge so the pipeline stops validating disposable intermediate histories.

text: Run the proof battery inside one immortal Bun supervisor that hot-swaps the candidate worktree beneath already-loaded compilers, scanners, and rule engines.
rationale: The glitch skips repeated process bootstrap, module parsing, rule discovery, and runtime initialization without weakening any gate.

text: Checkpoint a fully initialized CI runner in RAM and fork each hosted job from the same suspended machine image seconds after checkout injection.
rationale: Memory-forked runners bypass operating-system, toolchain, daemon, and dependency startup while preserving clean copy-on-write isolation.

text: Continuously assemble the 28 sibling branches into a speculative merge train, prove the train tip once, and issue each included PR a tree-membership attestation.
rationale: Many agent PRs ride one integration proof, with failed trains split by ancestry instead of paying the complete battery independently.

text: Make agents submit edits through proof-carrying codemods whose output grammar cannot violate selected laws, then let CI accept the codemod certificate in place of executing those law lanes.
rationale: Constrained transformations convert repeated detection into construction-time impossibility and make the patch itself the proof artifact.

text: Keep a shadow main permanently one merge ahead by racing the next queued PR against every plausible current-PR outcome, then fast-forward into the already-proven winning timeline.
rationale: Speculative execution hides entire PR-loop latency behind the preceding review and merge window.
